* HABS-HD cognitive status now says MCI/dementia
* ADGC status stays Cognitively unimpaired / Alzheimer’s disease
* Adds footnote clarifying outcome definitions
* APOE shown only as APOE ε4 carrier
* Smoking shown only as Smoker
* Physical activity shown as Physically active, high score only
* Drops vision loss
* Drops hearing loss
* Drops medication variables
* Uses continuous GDS if detected; otherwise falls back to GDS_Category
* Adds labels for main plasma biomarkers

---
title: "combined_adgc_habshd_table1"
output:
  word_document: default
---
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
target_lib <- "/wynton/home/andrews/rakshyasharma/R/rocky8-x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/4.4-CBI-gcc13"
.libPaths(c(target_lib, .libPaths()))
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(gtsummary)
library(openxlsx)
library(gt)
library(flextable)
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)
theme_gtsummary_compact()
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)
## -----------------------------
## Input paths: same RDS files as analysis
## -----------------------------
habshd_master_rds <- "/wynton/group/andrews/users/rakshyasharma/PRS/shared_data/habshd_master_df.rds"
adgc_rds <- "/wynton/group/andrews/users/rakshyasharma/PRS/compositePRS/results/rds/adgc_df_prs.rds"
## -----------------------------
## Output directories
## -----------------------------
## Use a stable absolute output directory so files do not move depending on
## where the Rmd is rendered from.
out_dir <- "/wynton/group/andrews/users/rakshyasharma/PRS/tables/results"
out_tbl_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "tables")
out_rds_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "rds")
dir.create(out_tbl_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(out_rds_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
## -----------------------------
## Load data
## -----------------------------
habshd_raw <- readRDS(habshd_master_rds)
adgc_raw <- readRDS(adgc_rds)
## -----------------------------
## Helper functions
## -----------------------------
check_required_columns <- function(df, required_cols, dataset_name = "dataset") {
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(df))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        dataset_name,
        " is missing required columns: ",
        paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
      )
    )
  }
}
safe_select_existing <- function(df, cols) {
  existing_cols <- cols[cols %in% names(df)]
  dplyr::select(df, dplyr::all_of(existing_cols))
}
as_numeric_clean <- function(x) {
  as.numeric(as.character(x))
}
first_existing_col <- function(df, candidates) {
  hit <- candidates[candidates %in% names(df)]
  if (length(hit) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  hit[1]
}
## -----------------------------
## HABS-HD required columns
## -----------------------------
habshd_required_cols <- c(
  "IID",
  "cognitive_impairment",
  "ID_Gender",
  "Age",
  "APOE4_Positivity",
  "ID_Education",
  "BW_CholTotal",
  "BW_LDLchol",
  "BW_HDLChol",
  "BW_Triglycerides",
  "BW_HbA1c",
  "OM_BMI",
  "OM_BP_DIA",
  "OM_BP_SYS",
  "Pulse_Pressure",
  "CDX_Hypertension",
  'CDX_Depression',
  "CDX_Diabetes",
  "AUDIT_Total",
  "SocialSupport_Total",
  "IMH_TBI",
  "Smoke",
  "RAPA_1_Total"
)

check_required_columns(
  habshd_raw,
  habshd_required_cols,
  dataset_name = "HABS-HD"
)

## Detect depression variable:
## Prefer continuous GDS if present; otherwise use categorical depression.
gds_var <- first_existing_col(
  habshd_raw,
  c(
    "GDS_Total",
    "GDS_total",
    "GDS",
    "GDS_Score",
    "GDS_score",
    "GDS15_Total",
    "GDS_15_Total"
  )
)

depression_var <- if (!is.na(gds_var)) {
  gds_var
} else if ("GDS_Category" %in% names(habshd_raw)) {
  "GDS_Category"
} else if ("CDX_Depression" %in% names(habshd_raw)) {
  "CDX_Depression"
} else {
  NA_character_
}

## -----------------------------
## Detect HABS-HD plasma biomarkers
## -----------------------------
candidate_plasma_biomarker_vars <- c(
  "ptau181",
  "ptau217",
  "pTau181",
  "pTau217",
  "PTAU181",
  "PTAU217",
  "ab42_ab40",
  "Aβ42/Aβ40",
  "AB42_AB40",
  "Abeta42_40",
  "Aβ42_Aβ40",
  "Aβ42.Aβ40",
  "nfl",
  "NfL",
  "NFL",
  "Neurofilament_Light",
  "tau",
  "TotalTau",
  "total_tau",
  "Ttau",
  "GFAP",
  "gfap"
)
plasma_biomarker_vars <- candidate_plasma_biomarker_vars[
  candidate_plasma_biomarker_vars %in% names(habshd_raw)
]
## -----------------------------
## Clean HABS-HD table variables
## -----------------------------
habshd_df <- habshd_raw %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    IID = as.character(IID),

    Sex = factor(
      ID_Gender,
      levels = c(1, 0),
      labels = c("Female", "Male")
    ),

    Cognitive_Status = factor(
      cognitive_impairment,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("Cognitively unimpaired", "MCI/dementia")
    ),

    APOE4_Positivity = as.integer(APOE4_Positivity),
    APOE4_Positivity = dplyr::if_else(
      APOE4_Positivity %in% c(0L, 1L),
      APOE4_Positivity,
      NA_integer_
    ),

    APOE4 = factor(
      APOE4_Positivity,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("Negative", "Positive")
    ),

    ## Smoking: make sure this is true smoking status.
    ## If Smoke is coded differently in HABS-HD, inspect table(habshd_raw$Smoke, useNA = "ifany").
    Smoker = factor(
      dplyr::case_when(
        as.character(Smoke) %in% c("1", "Yes", "yes", "Y", "Current", "current", "Smoker", "smoker", "Ever", "ever") ~ "Yes",
        as.character(Smoke) %in% c("0", "No", "no", "N", "Never", "never", "Non-smoker", "non-smoker") ~ "No",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      levels = c("No", "Yes")
    ),

    ## Physical activity: high score only shown in table.
    Physical_Activity = factor(
      dplyr::if_else(RAPA_1_Total > 6, "High Score", "Low Score"),
      levels = c("Low Score", "High Score")
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(plasma_biomarker_vars),
      as_numeric_clean
    )
  )

## Add depression variable after detection
if (!is.na(depression_var)) {
  if (depression_var == gds_var) {
    habshd_df <- habshd_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        Depression_Table = as_numeric_clean(.data[[depression_var]])
      )
  } else {
    habshd_df <- habshd_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        Depression_Table = factor(
          dplyr::case_when(
            as.character(.data[[depression_var]]) %in% c("1", "Yes", "yes", "Positive", "positive", "Depressed", "depressed") ~ "Yes",
            as.character(.data[[depression_var]]) %in% c("0", "No", "no", "Negative", "negative", "Not depressed", "not depressed") ~ "No",
            TRUE ~ NA_character_
          ),
          levels = c("No", "Yes")
        )
      )
  }
}

habshd_df <- habshd_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(Sex),
    !is.na(APOE4_Positivity)
  )
habshd_base_vars <- c(
  "Sex",
  "Age",
  "ID_Education",
  "Cognitive_Status",
  "APOE4",
  "OM_BMI",
  "BW_CholTotal",
  "BW_LDLchol",
  "BW_HDLChol",
  "BW_Triglycerides",
  "BW_HbA1c",
  "OM_BP_DIA",
  "OM_BP_SYS",
  "Pulse_Pressure",
  "Depression_Table",
  "CDX_Hypertension",
  "CDX_Diabetes",
  "CDX_Depression",
  "AUDIT_Total",
  "SocialSupport_Total",
  "IMH_TBI",
  "Smoker",
  "Physical_Activity"
)

habshd_table1_data <- habshd_df %>%
  safe_select_existing(c(habshd_base_vars, plasma_biomarker_vars))
## -----------------------------
## ADGC required columns
## -----------------------------
adgc_required_cols <- c(
  "Sex",
  "status",
  "aaoaae",
  "apoe4any"
)
check_required_columns(
  adgc_raw,
  adgc_required_cols,
  dataset_name = "ADGC"
)
## -----------------------------
## Clean ADGC table variables
## -----------------------------
## ADGC status is named Cognitive_Status only for row alignment in the merged Table 1.
adgc_table1_data <- adgc_raw %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Sex = factor(
      Sex,
      levels = c(2, 1),
      labels = c("Female", "Male")
    ),
    Cognitive_Status = factor(
      status,
      levels = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("Cognitively unimpaired", "Alzheimer's disease")
    ),
    Age = dplyr::if_else(
      as.numeric(aaoaae) >= 120,
      NA_real_,
      as.numeric(aaoaae)
    ),
    APOE4 = factor(
      apoe4any,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("Negative", "Positive")
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Sex,
    Age,
    Cognitive_Status,
    APOE4
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Sex))
## -----------------------------
## HABS-HD labels
## -----------------------------
habshd_label_list <- list(
  Age ~ "Age",
  ID_Education ~ "Education (years)",
  Cognitive_Status ~ "Cognitive status",
  APOE4 ~ "APOE ε4 carrier",
  OM_BMI ~ "BMI",
  BW_CholTotal ~ "Total cholesterol (mg/dL)",
  BW_LDLchol ~ "LDL cholesterol (mg/dL)",
  BW_HDLChol ~ "HDL cholesterol (mg/dL)",
  BW_Triglycerides ~ "Triglycerides (mg/dL)",
  BW_HbA1c ~ "HbA1c",
  OM_BP_DIA ~ "Diastolic BP (mmHg)",
  OM_BP_SYS ~ "Systolic BP (mmHg)",
  Pulse_Pressure ~ "Pulse pressure (mmHg)",
  CDX_Depression ~ "Clinical depression",
  CDX_Hypertension ~ "Hypertension",
  CDX_Diabetes ~ "Diabetes",
  AUDIT_Total ~ "Alcohol use score",
  SocialSupport_Total ~ "Social support score",
  IMH_TBI ~ "History of TBI",
  Smoker ~ "Smoker",
  Physical_Activity ~ "Physically active"
)
biomarker_label_map <- list(
  ptau181 ~ "pTau181",
  ptau217 ~ "pTau217",
  pTau181 ~ "pTau181",
  pTau217 ~ "pTau217",
  PTAU181 ~ "pTau181",
  PTAU217 ~ "pTau217",
  ab42_ab40 ~ "Aβ42/Aβ40",
  AB42_AB40 ~ "Aβ42/Aβ40",
  Abeta42_40 ~ "Aβ42/Aβ40",
  nfl ~ "NfL",
  NfL ~ "NfL",
  NFL ~ "NfL",
  Neurofilament_Light ~ "NfL",
  tau ~ "Total tau",
  TotalTau ~ "Total tau",
  total_tau ~ "Total tau",
  Ttau ~ "Total tau",
  GFAP ~ "GFAP",
  gfap ~ "GFAP"
)

for (bio_var in plasma_biomarker_vars) {
  if (bio_var %in% names(habshd_table1_data)) {
    label_expr <- biomarker_label_map[[bio_var]]
    if (!is.null(label_expr)) {
      habshd_label_list <- c(habshd_label_list, list(label_expr))
    }
  }
}
## -----------------------------
## HABS-HD gtsummary table
## -----------------------------
habshd_type_list <- list(
  APOE4 ~ "dichotomous",
  Smoker ~ "dichotomous",
  Physical_Activity ~ "dichotomous",
  dplyr::all_of(plasma_biomarker_vars) ~ "continuous"
)

habshd_value_list <- list(
  APOE4 ~ "Positive",
  Smoker ~ "Yes",
  Physical_Activity ~ "High Score"
)

if (!is.na(depression_var) && depression_var != gds_var) {
  habshd_type_list <- c(
    habshd_type_list,
    list(Depression_Table ~ "dichotomous")
  )

  habshd_value_list <- c(
    habshd_value_list,
    list(Depression_Table ~ "Yes")
  )
}
habshd_table1 <- habshd_table1_data %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = Sex,
    missing = "no",
    type = habshd_type_list,
    value = habshd_value_list,
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{p}%"
    ),
    digits = list(
      all_continuous() ~ 2,
      all_categorical() ~ 1
    ),
    label = habshd_label_list
  ) %>%
  add_p(
    test = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "t.test",
      all_categorical() ~ "chisq.test"
    )
  ) %>%
  modify_header(
    label ~ "**Characteristic**",
    stat_1 ~ "**Female**  \nN = {n}",
    stat_2 ~ "**Male**  \nN = {n}",
    p.value ~ "**P value**"
  )
## -----------------------------
## ADGC gtsummary table
## -----------------------------
adgc_table1 <- adgc_table1_data %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = Sex,
    missing = "no",
    type = list(
      APOE4 ~ "dichotomous"
    ),
    value = list(
      APOE4 ~ "Positive"
    ),
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{p}%"
    ),
    digits = list(
      all_continuous() ~ 2,
      all_categorical() ~ 1
    ),
    label = list(
      Cognitive_Status ~ "ADGC case-control status§",
      Age ~ "Age",
      APOE4 ~ "APOE ε4 carrier"
    )
  ) %>%
  add_p(
    test = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "t.test",
      all_categorical() ~ "chisq.test"
    )
  ) %>%
  modify_header(
    label ~ "**Characteristic**",
    stat_1 ~ "**Female**  \nN = {n}",
    stat_2 ~ "**Male**  \nN = {n}",
    p.value ~ "**P value**"
  )
## -----------------------------
## Remove ADGC automatic footnotes only
## This keeps one set of automatic footnotes from the merged table instead of repeating them twice.
## -----------------------------
adgc_table1$table_styling$footnote_header <- adgc_table1$table_styling$footnote_header[0, ]
adgc_table1$table_styling$footnote_body <- adgc_table1$table_styling$footnote_body[0, ]
## -----------------------------
## Merge HABS-HD and ADGC into one Table 1
## -----------------------------
combined_table1 <- tbl_merge(
  tbls = list(
    habshd_table1,
    adgc_table1
  ),
  tab_spanner = c(
    "**HABS-HD**",
    "**ADGC**"
  )
) %>%
  modify_caption(
    "**Table 1. Baseline characteristics of HABS-HD and ADGC analytic samples, stratified by sex**"
  )
table1_note <- paste0(
  "Values are mean (SD) for continuous variables and percentages for categorical variables. ",
  "†In HABS-HD, cognitive impairment includes MCI and dementia. ",
  "‡Physically active reflects the percentage classified in the high-score category. ",
  "§In ADGC, affected status reflects Alzheimer’s disease case status. ",
  "APOE ε4 carrier and smoker rows show the percentage in the positive category."
)
## -----------------------------
## Keep only one shared automatic footnote set
## -----------------------------
combined_table1$table_styling$footnote_body <- combined_table1$table_styling$footnote_body[0, ]
## -----------------------------
## Convert to gt and add clear source note
## -----------------------------
combined_table1_gt <- as_gt(combined_table1) %>%
  gt::tab_source_note(
    gt::md(table1_note)
  )
## -----------------------------
## Save outputs
## -----------------------------
saveRDS(
  habshd_table1_data,
  file.path(out_rds_dir, "habshd_table1_data.rds")
)
saveRDS(
  adgc_table1_data,
  file.path(out_rds_dir, "adgc_table1_data.rds")
)
saveRDS(
  combined_table1,
  file.path(out_rds_dir, "combined_table1_gtsummary.rds")
)
saveRDS(
  combined_table1_gt,
  file.path(out_rds_dir, "combined_table1_gt.rds")
)

## -----------------------------
## Save DOCX Table 1
## -----------------------------
combined_table1_flex <- gtsummary::as_flex_table(combined_table1) %>%
  flextable::add_footer_lines(
    values = paste0("Note: ", table1_note)
  ) %>%
  flextable::autofit()

flextable::save_as_docx(
  "Table 1. Baseline characteristics of HABS-HD and ADGC analytic samples, stratified by sex" = combined_table1_flex,
  path = file.path(out_tbl_dir, "Table1_combined_ADGC_HABSHD_by_sex.docx")
)
gt::gtsave(
  combined_table1_gt,
  filename = file.path(out_tbl_dir, "Table1_combined_ADGC_HABSHD_by_sex.html")
)
gt::gtsave(
  combined_table1_gt,
  filename = file.path(out_tbl_dir, "Table1_combined_ADGC_HABSHD_by_sex.rtf")
)
combined_xlsx <- file.path(out_tbl_dir, "Table1_combined_ADGC_HABSHD_source_data.xlsx")
wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "HABSHD_Table1_Data")
openxlsx::writeData(wb, "HABSHD_Table1_Data", habshd_table1_data)
openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "ADGC_Table1_Data")
openxlsx::writeData(wb, "ADGC_Table1_Data", adgc_table1_data)
openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb, combined_xlsx, overwrite = TRUE)
combined_table1
```
